title: AgentEvolver: System-Wide Self-Evolution Through Task Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.11613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent can complete a task without improving how it works. Turning task experience into reusable capability requires connecting the changed component to its evaluation and subsequent use. We present AgentEvolver, a system for developing capabilities during task execution while keeping the foundation model fixed. Eight entity families expose reusable operations, methods, agents, control flow, interfaces, and supporting state to revision through a common versioned lifecycle. A shared Runtime coordinates ongoing work, while persistent planning and recoverable context preserve task direction and supporting evidence. We evaluate task outcomes on SWE-bench Pro Public and examine capability changes in six application cases. The team reports an 82.08\% resolution rate with evolution, exceeding its reported baseline without evolution. translated_title: AgentEvolver：通过任务执行实现系统级的自我进化
translated_abstract: 智能体可以在不改进自身工作方式的情况下完成任务。将任务经验转化为可复用的能力，需要把发生变化的组件与其评估及后续使用联系起来。我们提出了AgentEvolver，这是一个在保持基础模型固定不变的前提下，在任务执行过程中发展能力的系统。八类实体族将可复用的操作、方法、智能体、控制流、接口以及支持状态暴露出来，通过统一的版本化生命周期进行修订。共享的运行时协调正在进行的任务，而持久化的规划与可恢复的上下文则保留任务方向和支持性证据。我们在SWE-bench Pro Public上评估任务结果，并在六个应用案例中考察能力的变化。该团队报告称，启用进化后达到82.08%的解决率，超过了其报告的无进化基线。案例显示，保留下来的能力被延续应用于后续的网站、游戏和研究工作中，同时也记录了……
tldr: AgentEvolver在基础模型保持固定的情况下，通过统一的版本化生命周期对八类可复用实体（操作、方法、智能体、控制流、接口等）进行修订，实现智能体系统的自我进化，在SWE-bench Pro Public上取得82.08%的解决率。
en_tdlr: AgentEvolver achieves system-wide self-evolution of agents during task execution—while keeping the foundation model fixed—by revising eight families of reusable entities through a common versioned lifecycle, reaching an 82.08% resolution rate on SWE-bench Pro Public.
